data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 2/5): AC-12/13 awk scoping must require the heading to be exactly '## Privacy Disclosure' at H2 (not H3), define the awk range as /^## Privacy Disclosure$/,/^## / with explicit EOF terminator, and require all three tokens (emit_excerpts=true, cited_excerpt, central-endpoint maintainer) found strictly within that range.
